\end{align}
where $\mathcal{F}$ is the usual Fourier transform and we recall that

Courr\`ege~\cite{courrege1966} showed that if $(\bm{A},\mathbf{D}(\bm{A}))$ is the generator of a Feller semigroup on $\mathbb{R}^d$ such that $\mathbf{C}^\infty_c(\mathbb{R}^d)\subseteq\mathbf{D}(\bm{A})$, then $A$ is a pseudo-differential operator with symbol $\mathbbm{a}(\bm{x},\bm{\xi})$ of the form
$$\mathbbm{a}(\bm{x},\bm{\xi})=\mathbbm{a}(\bm{x},\bm{0})-{\rm{i}}\langle\bm{\xi},\mathbf{b}(\bm{x})\rangle+\langle\bm{\xi}, Q(\bm{x})\bm{\xi}\rangle+\int_{\mathbb{R}^d\setminus\{0\}}(1-e^{{\rm{i}}\langle\bm{\xi},\bm{y}\rangle}+{\rm{i}}\langle\bm{\xi},\bm{y}\rangle\mathbbm{1}_{\{\|\bm{y}\|\leqslant 1\}})\mu(\bm{x},d\bm{y})$$
where,  for all $\bm{x}$, $\mathbbm{a}(\bm{x},\bm{0})\geqslant 0$, $Q(\bm{x})$ is non-negative definite, $\mathbf{b}:\mathbb{R}^d\to\mathbb{R}^d$ is measurable and  $\mu(\bm{x},d\bm{y})$ is a L\'evy measure, i.e.~ $\int_{\mathbb{R}^d}(\|\bm{y}\|^2\wedge 1)\mu(\bm{x},d\bm{y})<\infty$.

nodes.statement: We point out that although the identity relates, on the dense subset D_psi, A_mathttPDO with the bmrmL(R,e)- and Feller generator of a L\'evy process, we can not yet conclude that A_mathttPDO coincides on this set with the bmrmL(R, e)-generator of the log-Lamperti semigroup, as a representation of such generator is not available. Indeed, Lamperti provides only the representation of the generator as a Dynkin operator due to the delicate application of the Volskonskii's formula in this context. However, under the condition on the Wiener-Hopf factors of psi, we shall show that the Dynkin representation coincides with the Feller (and also the bmrmL(R, e)) one. To deal with the remaining cases, we will prove and use the fact that our class of PDO's as well as the log-Lamperti class is stable by taking the adjoint in bmrmL(R, e).

\label{rem:PDO_Dynk}
We point out that although the identity \eqref{eq:PDO_L} relates, on the dense subset $\mathbf{D}_\psi$, $A_\mathtt{PDO}$ with the $\bmrm{L}(\mathbb{R},e)$- and  Feller generator of a L\'evy process, we can not yet conclude that  $A_\mathtt{PDO}$ coincides on this set with the $\bmrm{L}(\mathbb{R}, e)$-generator of the log-Lamperti semigroup, as a representation of such generator is not available. Indeed, Lamperti \cite{Lamperti1972} provides only the representation of the generator as a Dynkin operator due to the delicate application  of the Volskonskii's formula in this context. However, under the condition \eqref{eq:mpsi_bound_2} on the Wiener-Hopf factors of $\psi$, we shall show that the Dynkin representation coincides with the Feller (and also the $\bmrm{L}(\mathbb{R}, e)$) one. To deal with the remaining cases, we will prove and use the fact  that our class of PDO's as well as the log-Lamperti class is stable by taking the adjoint in $\bmrm{L}(\mathbb{R}, e)$.
